name: Survey
description: Observes Mars from orbit, which lowers the landing risk of the known Landing Sites and reveals a new one.

name: Orbital research
description: Studies the atmosphere and climate of Mars from orbit, in place of a Survey.

name: Surface research
description: Studies the rocks and weather around the Landing Site.

name: Soil analysis
description: Stays near the Landing Site and analyses soil samples, which pays a Research Grant.

name: Long traverse
description: Drives long distances around the Landing Site and finds more, but pays no Research Grant. The other Landing Sites are too far away to reach.

name: Nothing
description: Stays in place and does no work this Turn.
